## Starting models

Runs name their starting model in `run.yml` (`start_model: alaska-3d`), and the run page links here. The slider shows Vp at each depth. The 1D model is opened beside the 3D model for comparison.

::: {data-akviewer="" data-src="models.json" data-mode="model" data-start="alaska-3d" data-compare="alaska-1d"}
:::

## Pick sets {#picks}

Runs name the picks they inverted in `run.yml` (`picks: ...`). Checkerboard runs use `synthetic`: travel times computed through the checkerboard model, with no real picks.

| Name | Receivers | Phases | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `synthetic` | DAS + BB | P, S | In use | Eikonal travel times through the checkerboard model for the 400 catalog events |
| `phasenet-das-gradient` | DAS | P, S | Testing | PhaseNet-DAS run on the spatial gradient of the data, which picked better than the raw data |
| `ensemble-denoised` | DAS | P, S | Testing | Denoise-then-pick ensemble workflow ([Picking](../picking/index.qmd)) |
| `alex-das` | DAS | P, S | Outdated | Alex's earlier DAS picks; quality categorized in the pick-quality sheet |
| `phasenet-bb`, `aec-bb` | BB | P, S | Testing | Broadband picks from PhaseNet and AEC |
| `final` | DAS + BB | P, S | Not yet | Final pick set for the field-data inversion |

## Receivers and events

- **DAS cables:** KKFLS, TERRA, and KKFLN in Cook Inlet. Channel coordinates are in `AlaskaTomography/cable_info/`.
- **Broadband stations:** `AlaskaTomography/stations/all_stations.csv` (AK network plus Badger stations).
- **Events:** 400 USGS-cataloged earthquakes, cleaned in `cleaning_usgs_catalog.ipynb` → `catalogs/clean_AK_events.csv`.
